name: VRM_ACCOUNTING_EVENTS_GT
description: This is a temporary table which is used internally by Oracle.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Revenue management accounting event unique identifier.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Source document line unique identifier

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Accounting event type. Values are from the lookup VRM_ACCOUNTING_EVENT_TYPE.

columns.name: REFERENCE_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Reference to the identifier of the event that triggered the accounting event.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date of the accounting event.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Accounting event amount in the performance obligation currency.

columns.name: ACCTD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accounting event amount in the revenue contract currency.

columns.name: CONTRACT_ACTIVITY_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Customer contract activity group identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Customer contract header unique identifier.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation unique identifier.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation line unique identifier.

columns.name: DEVOLVED_PERF_OBLIG_DTL_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Detailed devolved performance obligation unique record identifier. Value in this column is populated only for initial performance event type accounting events of devolved performance obligations.

columns.name: REVERSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the accounting event was reversed. Blank indicates reversed.

columns.name: REVERSED_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or marked this row as reversed.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier of customer contract.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Accounting event processing status. Values are from the lookup ORA_ACCOUNTING_EVENT_STATUS.

columns.name: PROCESSED_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that processed this row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: POB_FIRST_BE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the current event being processed is the first billing event after sorting based on the accounting date under the performance obligation.

columns.name: POB_FIRST_SE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if current event being processed is the first satisfaction event after sorting based on the accounting date under the performance obligation line.

columns.name: POB_ENTER_CUR_ALLOCATED_AMT
columns.description: Total allocated transaction price in the performance obligation currency at the performance obligation level.

columns.name: POB_CONTR_CUR_ALLOCATED_AMT
columns.description: Total allocated transaction price in the revenue contract currency at the performance obligation level.

columns.name: POB_TOTAL_AE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total accounting event amount for satisfaction events in the performance obligation currency at the performance obligation level.

columns.name: POB_TOTAL_AE_ACCTD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total accounted satisfaction event amount in the contract currency at the performance obligation level.

columns.name: DEVOLVED_PDL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Promised detail line amount that is apportioned by accounting period. This amount is used to compute the devolved performance obligation amount while creating a record in the devolved performance obligation details entity.

columns.name: POL_CONTR_CUR_NET_CONSIDER_AMT
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.  Net consideration amount  of the promised detail line in the contract currency. This amount is used to determine if there is any rounding difference. Sum total amount of the column value of DEVOLVED_PDL_AMOUNT is compared with the value of this column to determine the rounding difference amount.

columns.name: DEVOLVE_PO_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates if the performance obligation of this record is devolved. A performance obligation is devolved if the Devolve performance obligation option is set to Yes in either the performance obligation identification rule or the implied obligation template that was used during identification of the performance obligations.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Start date of the satisfaction event period of a promised detail line. The value in this column is populated only for satisfaction event type accounting events that are related to promised detail lines with a satisfaction measurement model of Measure Period Satisfied.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_EVENT_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.description: Sequence number of the accounting event record.

columns.name: POB_LAST_EVENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the current event being processed is the last satisfaction or billing event after sorting based on the accounting date under the performance obligation.

columns.name: POL_LAST_SE_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates whether the current accounting event is the last satisfaction event, after sorting it based on the accounting date under the promised detail line. For a promised detail line, if there is any rounding difference between the sum of the devolved line amount and the net consideration amount, the difference is adjusted on the accounting event when this column is set to Yes.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_EVENT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Used during internal processing to identify whether the accounting event is newly created or not.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: The allocation currency basis used to allocate and recognize revenue for a contract. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_ALLOCATION_METHOD.
